now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#19
now.text: Harry and Gwen are both Peter's best friends. Gwen is the only one who notices Harry taking a dangerous formula and wants him to quit.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend who wants Harry off the Green.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend Gwen worries about.

changes.evidence: Episode 19 (Growing Pains) is where Harry and Gwen start dating, so a 'friend' stage at #19 is wrong; the friendship and Gwen's worry about Harry's strange behavior belong to season 1 (in #8 Reaction, Gwen and Peter agree they must talk to Harry about his behavior; Harry is already on Globulin Green). Stage 1 (partner) should then carry the title The Spectacular Spider-Man#19. Exact season-1 episode for Gwen's concern is medium confidence.

now.title: What If...?
now.text: Ultron attacks the Eminence to free the Watcher and Peggy, and the Eminence kills him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Attacks the Eminence, who kills him.

changes.evidence: Ultron frees the Watcher and Peggy and is killed by the Eminence in S3E8 'What If... What If?' (episode 26 overall). A whole-show title puts this season-3 finale event at the show's start.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9
now.text: Gideon Malick has Jemma and Fitz captured and brought to his Hydra castle because he wants to know how she made it back from the planet Maveth. The two refuse to help him open the portal to bring Hive to Earth.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Scientist Malick has captured to learn how she escaped Maveth.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra leader who captures Jemma to learn about Maveth.

proposed.text: Gideon Malick's Hydra captures Jemma and Fitz and brings them to its castle, because he wants to know how she made it back from the planet Maveth. Hydra tortures Jemma until Fitz agrees to go through the portal to bring Hive to Earth.

changes.evidence: AoS S3E9 'Closure': Giyera tortures Simmons at the Hydra Castle until Fitz agrees to go through the Monolith portal for Malick; they do not both refuse.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
now.text: Giyera, a telekinetic Inhuman loyal to Hydra and then to Hive, tries to shoot Daisy as she hacks into Hydra's castle. When the Secret Warriors storm Hydra's base to retake Zephyr One, Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra's telekinetic Inhuman. Tries to shoot Daisy, and later serves Hive.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Blasts Giyera with a shockwave and knocks him out.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
proposed.text: Giyera, Malick's telekinetic Inhuman, floats a gun to shoot Daisy as she hacks into Hydra's systems at its castle. Joey melts the bullets and Lincoln knocks Giyera down.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Malick's telekinetic Inhuman. Tries to shoot Daisy at the Hydra castle.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman Giyera tries to shoot as she hacks Hydra's castle.

changes.evidence: Giyera's attempt to shoot Daisy while she hacks the Hydra Castle is in S3E10 'Maveth' (AoS310), not #17; the shockwave knockout is #17. Their enmity starts at #10, so the stage moves earlier and the #17 facts go to a later stage (see the added stage). The old card line 'later serves Hive' would spoil #15-16 at #10.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
proposed.text: Now loyal to Hive, Giyera fights the Secret Warriors as they storm Hydra's base to retake Zephyr One, and Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Hive's telekinetic follower. Daisy knocks him out with a shockwave.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Blasts Giyera with a shockwave and knocks him out.

changes.evidence: Split remainder of stage 0: in S3E17 'The Team' Giyera, now Hive's, attacks the Secret Warriors at the Schoonebeek base and Daisy's shockwave knocks him out.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#8
now.text: Director Jeffrey Mace leads the S.H.I.E.L.D. team that storms Eli Morrow's Chinatown Crew headquarters. He reluctantly lets Ghost Rider help stop Morrow, insisting Robbie will answer for his crimes later.
now.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. director who storms Eli's Chinatown headquarters.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Darkhold villain whose headquarters Mace storms.

proposed.text: Director Jeffrey Mace leads the S.H.I.E.L.D. team that storms Eli Morrow's Chinatown Crew headquarters. He reluctantly lets Ghost Rider join the strike team, as long as Robbie stays out of the press's sight.

changes.evidence: In S4E8 Mace approves Reyes and Daisy for the strike team only if they keep a low profile and argues about using murderers like Reyes; his line that Reyes would pay for his crimes is from S4E6 'The Good Samaritan'.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#7
now.text: Director Jeffrey Mace brings Holden Radcliffe in as a consultant, briefing him on Eli Morrow and handing him strange boxes that draw energy from the multiverse. Mace also lets Jemma Simmons take Melinda May to Radcliffe to save her life.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Director who brings Radcliffe in as a consultant.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Scientist Mace brings in to consult.

proposed.text: Director Jeffrey Mace brings Holden Radcliffe in as a consultant, briefing him on Eli Morrow and handing him strange boxes that draw energy from the multiverse.

changes.evidence: Mace letting Simmons take May to Radcliffe to save her happens in S4E3 'Uprising', not S4E7; the S4E7 part (Mace thanks/briefs Radcliffe at the Playground about the Quantum Batteries) is correct.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
now.text: Nebula fights Drax and his allies on Knowhere on Ronan's orders.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Ronan's ally. Fights Drax on Knowhere.
now.on_b_card_about_a: One of the heroes Nebula fights on Knowhere.

proposed.text: Nebula hunts Drax's friends across Knowhere on Ronan's orders. On the Dark Aster, Drax blasts her with a rocket launcher.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ronan's ally. Drax blasts her on the Dark Aster.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: One of the heroes who blasts Nebula on the Dark Aster.

changes.evidence: Guardians of the Galaxy: on Knowhere Ronan fights Drax while Nebula chases Gamora's pod; the two clash on the Dark Aster, where Drax shoots Nebula with a Kyln bazooka.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#12
now.text: Deke Shaw tracks down Mike Peterson while searching for agents still loyal to S.H.I.E.L.D., and Mike flies in with them to help save the Lighthouse. At Fitz and Simmons' wedding, Deke asks him which side he is on, and Mike says he knows them both.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who recruits Mike to help save the Lighthouse.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal agent Deke tracks down, who helps save the Lighthouse.

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A scavenger who recruits Mike to help save the Lighthouse.

changes.evidence: In S5E12 'The Real Deal' Deke is not a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent; he is the 2091 scavenger who rounds up loyal agents including Deathlok (the 'bride's side or groom's side' / 'I know them both' exchange checks out).

now.title: Secret Invasion
now.text: Raava replaces James Rhodes and impersonates him for years. Fury eventually exposes and kills her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Skrull who replaced Rhodes and wore his face for years.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The man Raava replaced and impersonated for years.

proposed.text: Raava replaces James Rhodes and impersonates him in the U.S. government. Fury eventually exposes and kills her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Skrull who replaced Rhodes and wore his face.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The man Raava replaced and impersonated.

changes.evidence: Secret Invasion never says how long Raava posed as Rhodes (fandom: 'By 2026, Rhodes had his likeness stolen'); 'for years' is unsourced. Fury shoots her in the finale.

now.title: The Punisher S1#1
now.text: Carson Wolf is Dinah's superior at Homeland Security. Secretly he works against her investigation.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Wolf's subordinate at Homeland Security, whose investigation he secretly undermines.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Madani's boss at Homeland Security, secretly working against her investigation.

proposed.text: Carson Wolf is Dinah's superior at Homeland Security, and he orders her to drop her investigation into Ahmad Zubair's death.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Wolf's subordinate at Homeland Security, whom he orders off the Zubair case.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Madani's boss at Homeland Security, who orders her off the Zubair case.

changes.evidence: In The Punisher S1E1 '3 AM' Wolf openly orders Madani off the Zubair case; that he secretly works for Rawlins' Operation Cerberus against her is first shown in S1E2 'Two Dead Men'.
